key_metrics.WPM: Words Per Minute — (Total Characters ÷ 5) ÷ Time in Minutes
key_metrics.KDPH: Key Depressions Per Hour — WPM × 300 (used in SSC exams)
key_metrics.Net_Accuracy: Percentage of correctly typed characters vs total characters
